formDescription: Sub-screen for the 'youthincarechild' request topic. Lets the applicant, requesting as a child/youth in care or receiving services, select which record types they want. Youth justice records specifically cannot be processed under FOIPPA and must be requested directly from the Ministry of Children and Family Development by mail.

youth_in_care_child_selection.title: Select the corresponding types of records you would like to receive in your request
youth_in_care_child_selection.description: The more selected, the larger the resulting request. Each main option, once checked, reveals its own set of record-type sub-options (each with an info tooltip describing that record type in the UI).

options.label: Child and Youth Mental Health Records
options.value: Child and Youth Mental Health Records
suboptions: Child & Youth Mental Health Case Files

options.label: Child and Youth Special Needs Records
options.value: Child and Youth Special Needs Records

notes: Main/sub options are loaded dynamically from web/src/app/services/data.json (referenceData.youthincarechild). Component's FormGroup also declares unused boolean fields (ischildincardrecords, ismentalhealthrecords, isspecialneedsrecords, isyouthagreement, isyouthjustice, isother) that are not bound to any template control.
